CustomField.description: How many of the requested days have no leave balance behind them. Calculated by LeaveWithoutPayService: provisionally on every save, authoritatively at approval. Only leave types with Counts Toward LWOP Check on their Leave Type Policy are assessed; every other type stays at zero.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days of this request that will be unpaid because the balance does not cover them. Calculated automatically - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Unpaid (LWOP) Days
